entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and Shri Sanjay Kumar Singh, learned counsel for respondent no.3.
2.

This petition has been filed by the petitioner inter alia seeking direction to the respondents to issue appropriate certificate in Form-26AS/Form-16A in lieu of disbursement of compensation for acquisition of his land.
3. Submissions have been made that while making payment of amount of compensation for acquisition of petitioner's land, a sum of Rs.1,51,928/- was deducted as TDS.

However, the requisite form in this regard has not been supplied to the petitioner nor the same is reflected in the record of Vijay Kumar Jaiswal vs State Of Up And 3 Others on 16 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/80357648/
1

entities.text: Vijay Kumar Jaiswal vs State Of Up And 3 Others on 16 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
the Income Tax Department qua the petitioner's PAN number and, therefore, the respondents be directed to issue the certificate in this regard.
4. Learned counsel for the respondents does not dispute the fact that amount has been deducted as TDS in terms of circulars issued under Section 194 of the Income Tax Act, 1961 and submits that requisite Form-26AS/Form-16A would be supplied to the petitioner.
5.
In view of above fact situation, the petition filed by the petitioner is disposed of.
The respondent no.3/4 is directed to issue the requisite certificate to the petitioner preferably within a period of four weeks from the date of this order.

(Manoj Kumar Gupta, J.) (Arun Bhansali, C.J.)
